Four European Nations Back India's Permanent UNSC Seat Bid

Poland, Hungary, Slovakia, and the Czech Republic have expressed support for India's bid to secure a permanent seat on the United Nations Security Council. This backing from the four European nations is seen as a significant boost to India's aspirations for a permanent UNSC position.
